image.alt: A construction worker in a hard hat and safety vest reading plans on site

default.title: Twenty years on site
default.text: Brian watched good crews go unfilled while good workers went unfound. The same week, every week, on both sides of the same fence.

image.alt: Two construction workers in hard hats looking at a tablet on site

default.title: Hiring never got easier
default.text: Job boards returned resumes with no licence check. Agencies took a cut of every hour worked. Small firms had neither the time nor the budget for either.

image.alt: A construction worker shaking hands with a man in a suit on site

default.title: So we built the connection
default.text: One profile for workers. One post for companies. Nobody in the middle taking a cut of anyone's hours.
